title: How Gender Interacts with Political Values: A Case Study on Czech BERT Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'political values' (specifically anti-authoritarianism, cultural liberalism, economic equity, and tribalism) using a sociological survey. While it mentions moral intuitions in its literature review, the actual benchmarking and case study are centered on political alignment and gender bias rather than religion, faith, or a general framework for ethics.
